record_title: Besicovitch threshold for anisotropic parabolic metrics
provenance: An exact higher-anisotropy extension of the parabolic Besicovitch threshold from Nikita Dobronravov, arXiv:2609.15560v1, for the explicit metrics d_{p,a}= (|x-y|^p+|t-s|^{p/a})^{1/p}.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem is proved for anisotropy a>=2 and finite p; it does not settle 1<a<2 in the intermediate range a<=p<2, does not include the max metric p=infinity, and does not claim optimal numerical covering constants. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
